steps: Home rendered signed in, before any project existed
A fresh server had no Development workflow; the New project dialog listed only the default. Published it with the setup API, reloaded so the cached list refreshed, then chose it in the form.
Created project Orbit Development (4939d23d-4f9c-437c-bf21-4aca00321e4f) with the Development workflow through the dialog
Created 18 tasks through the New task dialog
Created milestones M31 completion and Reference-client ready through the milestones view
Set priorities, labels, initial statuses, Markdown descriptions, acceptance criteria and dependencies in the drawer

Created one Feature work item (1ce5d4bf-d612-48c6-937b-90793d55ab05); declared fields: Priority*
(required) / Medium / Cancel / Create work item /
Created knowledge note i5-dogfooding.md through the vault dialog
Linked the note from the task description and verified the rendered link
Triaged “Triage: capture I5 friction before the gate” from Home → Inbox into the project, priority High
Authored 240 minutes; the server returned 3 “missing an estimate” rows and 0 slots; review disabled=true
Completed “I5: write the dogfooding findings summary” (dac48ec8-8d23-4e16-aa41-f44747c09ad8) through description, criteria, attachment, Ready → In progress → Done; activity visible
Restarted the server between tasks; the session, the completed task and its board column survived a reload
Completed “I5: record the board keyboard move evidence” from the board with two keyboard moves (Ready → In progress → Done, m → arrow → Enter, 9 ArrowDown presses, no pointer used for the move)
Reviewed milestone progress; settings honestly reported no newer published workflow version
